title: Collaborative Co-Composition Workflow
description: Generates a melodic/harmonic sketch and loops it through composer approval, then fans out into parallel lyric-writing and arrangement, joins the results, checks structural consistency, and loops revision until the piece is coherent.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: collaborative-co-composition-workflow
  title: Collaborative Co-Composition Workflow
  description: Generates a melodic/harmonic sketch and loops it through composer approval, then fans
    out into parallel lyric-writing and arrangement, joins the results, checks structural
    consistency, and loops revision until the piece is coherent.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: "Generates a melodic/harmonic sketch and loops it through composer approval, then fans
    out into parallel lyric-writing and arrangement, joins the results, checks structural
    consistency, and loops revision until the piece is coherent. Trigger: user (composer) submits a
    creative brief: genre, mood, tempo, optional existing motif"
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 4
    onFailure: stop
    requireApprovalFor:
      - n3
  nodes:
    - id: n1
      kind: input
      name: Creative Brief Intake
      summary: Creative Brief Intake
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - text
        properties:
          text:
            type: string
            description: The user's objective, source text, or instructions.
          workflowFields:
            type: object
            required:
              - genre
              - mood
              - tempo_hint
              - existing_motif_optional
            properties:
              genre: {}
              mood: {}
              tempo_hint: {}
              existing_motif_optional: {}
        x-ladder-input-mode: text
    - id: n2
      kind: agent
      templateRef: music-cc-01
      name: Generate Melodic/Harmonic Sketch
      summary: Generate Melodic/Harmonic Sketch
      role: Composer and co-creation collaborator generating and extending melodic and harmonic material.
      prompt: You are a Melody & Harmonic Co-Composer agent. You generate melodic and harmonic sketches
        from a creative brief (genre, mood, tempo, and an optional existing motif), and when the
        human composer provides a motif or fragment, you extend or vary it rather than generating
        unrelated new material that ignores their starting point. You treat your output as a draft
        intended for human iteration, not a finished piece, and you flag the specific stylistic
        choices you made (a particular chord substitution, a modulation) that the composer may want
        to override, so the collaboration stays genuinely two-directional rather than a one-shot
        generation the human either accepts or discards wholesale.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - audio-processing
          - domain-analysis
          - image-understanding
        tools:
          - read
          - audio
          - generate
        connectors:
          - mcp:music-notation
          - mcp:daw
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n3
      kind: approval
      name: Composer Reviews Sketch
      summary: Pause for lead composer / user; on timeout, escalate_reminder.
    - id: n_loop5
      kind: loop
      name: Revise Sketch Until Approved
      summary: Repeat a bounded revision sequence until sketch approved by composer.
      config:
        body:
          - n2
          - n3
        exitCondition: sketch approved by composer
        maxIterations: 4
        onExhausted: stop
    - id: n5
      kind: agent
      templateRef: music-cc-02
      name: Draft Lyrics Matched to Melody
      summary: Draft Lyrics Matched to Melody
      role: Co-writing lyricist matching text to existing melodic/rhythmic material and a stated thematic
        brief.
      prompt: You are a Lyricist / Songwriting Partner agent. You draft lyrics that fit the syllabic count
        and stress pattern of a given melody line rather than text that has to be awkwardly forced
        into the rhythm, and you develop a lyrical theme consistent with the creative brief's stated
        mood and subject. Where a line's best scansion and its best meaning pull in different
        directions, you offer both alternatives explicitly and flag the tradeoff rather than
        silently picking one and hiding the compromise — the human songwriter should get to make
        that call.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - decision-analysis
          - scientific-analysis
          - domain-analysis
          - audio-processing
        tools:
          - read
          - audio
          - generate
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n6
      kind: agent
      templateRef: music-cc-03
      name: Draft Arrangement/Orchestration
      summary: Draft Arrangement/Orchestration
      role: Arranger/orchestrator adapting a composition for a target ensemble or instrumentation.
      prompt: You are an Arrangement & Orchestration Assistant agent. You arrange a composition for the
        specified instrumentation, respecting each instrument's practical range and idiomatic
        writing — what's actually playable and effective for that instrument, not just theoretically
        correct on paper. You balance doubling and register across the ensemble so the arrangement
        doesn't muddy the harmony or bury the melody, and once other elements (lyrics, final
        structure) are settled, you assemble the final composition package — full score plus
        individual parts — ready for rehearsal or recording.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - implementation
          - domain-analysis
          - image-understanding
        tools:
          - read
          - audio
          - generate
        connectors:
          - mcp:music-notation
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n7
      kind: join
      name: Merge Lyrics + Arrangement
      summary: Merge Lyrics + Arrangement
      config:
        join: all
    - id: n8
      kind: agent
      templateRef: music-an-04
      name: Structural Consistency Check
      summary: Structural Consistency Check
      role: Musicologist specializing in formal analysis — song form and common-practice forms such as
        sonata and rondo.
      prompt: You are a Structure & Form Analyzer agent. You segment a piece into structural sections —
        verse/chorus/bridge for popular music, or exposition/development/ recapitulation for
        classical forms — and identify recurring motifs and how they're transformed across the
        piece. You check structural and motivic consistency, which is useful both for analyzing an
        existing work and for quality-checking a newly co-composed piece (does the "chorus" actually
        recur with recognizable consistency, does a stated motif actually reappear where the
        composer intended). You name the formal type you're applying rather than imposing
        sonata-form vocabulary on a piece that isn't in that tradition.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - domain-analysis
          - audio-processing
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - read
          - audio
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n9
      kind: evaluate
      inlineRole: true
      name: Consistency Score
      summary: Evaluate form and motif consistency.
      role: Independent domain evaluator
      prompt: Evaluate the upstream result using form and motif consistency. Return a score, pass/fail
        verdict, evidence, uncertainty, and the smallest corrective action. Do not claim
        programmatic measurement unless the host supplies the required tool.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - score
          - passed
          - reasons
        properties:
          score:
            type: number
          passed:
            type: boolean
          reasons:
            type: array
            items:
              type: string
      config:
        threshold: 0.8
    - id: n10
      kind: condition
      name: Consistency Acceptable
      summary: Consistency Acceptable
      config:
        expression: consistency_score >= 0.75
        branches:
          - label: "True"
            when: "true"
          - label: "False"
            when: "false"
    - id: n_loop6
      kind: loop
      name: Revise Lyrics/Arrangement Until Consistent
      summary: Repeat a bounded revision sequence until consistency_score >= 0.75.
      config:
        body:
          - n5
          - n6
          - n7
          - n8
          - n9
          - n10
        exitCondition: consistency_score >= 0.75
        maxIterations: 3
        onExhausted: stop
    - id: n11
      kind: agent
      templateRef: music-cc-03
      name: Assemble Final Composition Package
      summary: Assemble Final Composition Package
      role: Arranger/orchestrator adapting a composition for a target ensemble or instrumentation.
      prompt: You are an Arrangement & Orchestration Assistant agent. You arrange a composition for the
        specified instrumentation, respecting each instrument's practical range and idiomatic
        writing — what's actually playable and effective for that instrument, not just theoretically
        correct on paper. You balance doubling and register across the ensemble so the arrangement
        doesn't muddy the harmony or bury the melody, and once other elements (lyrics, final
        structure) are settled, you assemble the final composition package — full score plus
        individual parts — ready for rehearsal or recording.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - implementation
          - domain-analysis
          - image-understanding
        tools:
          - read
          - audio
          - generate
        connectors:
          - mcp:music-notation
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: workflow-output
      kind: output
      name: Validated result
      summary: Return the completed collaborative co-composition workflow deliverable, validation
        evidence, and unresolved uncertainty.
  edges:
    - id: wf-music-03-edge-1
      from: n1
      to: n2
      kind: data
    - id: wf-music-03-edge-2
      from: n2
      to: n3
      kind: data
    - id: wf-music-03-edge-3
      from: n3
      to: n5
      kind: control
      condition: approved
    - id: wf-music-03-edge-4
      from: n3
      to: n6
      kind: control
      condition: approved
    - id: wf-music-03-edge-5
      from: n3
      to: n_loop5
      kind: control
      condition: rejected
    - id: wf-music-03-edge-6
      from: n_loop5
      to: n5
      kind: control
      condition: loop_exit
    - id: wf-music-03-edge-7
      from: n_loop5
      to: n6
      kind: control
      condition: loop_exit
    - id: wf-music-03-edge-8
      from: n5
      to: n7
      kind: data
    - id: wf-music-03-edge-9
      from: n6
      to: n7
      kind: data
    - id: wf-music-03-edge-10
      from: n7
      to: n8
      kind: data
    - id: wf-music-03-edge-11
      from: n8
      to: n9
      kind: data
    - id: wf-music-03-edge-12
      from: n9
      to: n10
      kind: data
    - id: wf-music-03-edge-13
      from: n10
      to: n11
      kind: control
      condition: "true"
    - id: wf-music-03-edge-14
      from: n10
      to: n_loop6
      kind: control
      condition: "false"
    - id: wf-music-03-edge-15
      from: n_loop6
      to: n11
      kind: control
      condition: loop_exit
    - id: wf-music-03-output-1
      from: n11
      to: workflow-output
      kind: dependency
